title: Rafael Campos-Gottardo
text:
I am researcher interested in using data science techniques to create data informed policy recommendations. I am interested in using quantitative research methods to study urban policy and planning. I have previously contributed to the Canadian Election Study (CES) and worked extensively as a research assistant for the Laurier Institute for the Study of Public Opinion and Policy (LISPOP), Université du Québec à Montréal, and the Centre for the Study of Democratic Citizenship.
I previously revived a Master’s Degree in Political Science from McGill University and a Bachelor’s degree in Political Science from Wilfrid Laurier University.
